input.summary: Spell BATMAN at the Flugelheim target, start two-ball play at the opened Museum, put both balls back into the Museum for three-ball play, then relight and collect the Museum Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: BATMAN and the Museum
quickInfo.summary: Flugelheim hits spell BATMAN; completion drops the target and opens the Museum for two-ball play.

quickInfo.name: Three-ball Multiball
quickInfo.summary: During two-ball play, put both balls into the Museum to release all three balls.

quickInfo.name: Museum Jackpot
quickInfo.summary: During three-ball play, hit Flugelheim once to light the Museum, then shoot the Museum for Jackpot.

quickInfo.name: Joker Jump
quickInfo.summary: Either eye scores 2M; complete both eyes to light the mouth for 4M.

quickInfo.name: Ramp values
quickInfo.summary: A lit ramp collects its displayed award; an unlit ramp spots one Young Jack or Old Jack target.

steps.text: Use the opening ball to test the Flugelheim rebound, Museum eject, ramp return, and Batcave feed.
Spell BATMAN with Flugelheim-target hits; a left-return-lane feed into Flugelheim spots two letters.
After BATMAN is complete and Flugelheim drops, shoot the open Museum to start two-ball play.
During two-ball play, put both balls into the Museum to release all three balls.
During three-ball play, hit Flugelheim once to light the Museum for Jackpot.
Shoot the lit Museum for Jackpot before returning to the qualification cycle.
modeNotes: Museum sequence: Complete BATMAN, start two-ball play at the Museum, put both balls back into the Museum, then hit Flugelheim and collect the lit Museum Jackpot.

fallback.title: Ramp and Jack-target route
fallback.when: Use this when Flugelheim or the Museum eject is rejecting.

steps.text: Shoot the ramp while its return reaches a controlled flipper.
When the ramp is unlit, use it to spot a remaining Young Jack or Old Jack target.
When a ramp value is lit, collect it rather than forcing the Museum path.

alternatives.title: Joker Jump cashout
alternatives.when: Use this when the Joker face registers cleanly and the Museum path does not.

steps.text: Shoot each Joker eye for 2M.
After both eyes register, shoot the lit mouth for 4M.
Return to the ramp or Batcave after the eject settles.
Spell BATMAN at Flugelheim.
Start two-ball play at the opened Museum.
Put both balls back into the Museum for three-ball play.
Hit Flugelheim and collect the lit Museum Jackpot.

playfieldReferences.label: BATMAN and Jackpot target
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-right target used to spell BATMAN and light the Museum Jackpot during three-ball play.

playfieldReferences.label: Museum lock
playfieldReferences.description: The upper-right lock used to start two-ball play, build three-ball play, and collect Jackpot.
playfieldReferences.context: Museum: The upper-right lock used to start two-ball play, build three-ball play, and collect Jackpot.

playfieldReferences.label: Joker collect
playfieldReferences.description: The center hole in the Joker face, lit by the two eyes.
playfieldReferences.context: Joker mouth: The center hole in the Joker face, lit by the two eyes.

techniques.name: Left-return letter spot
techniques.instruction: Use a safe left-return-lane feed into Flugelheim to spot two BATMAN letters.

cautions.issue: Both balls must reach the Museum during two-ball play before three-ball play begins.
cautions.response: Keep one ball controlled when possible and avoid mistaking the first Museum lock for the three-ball start.

cautions.issue: Early and later ROMs can display different version identifiers and feature behavior.
cautions.response: Use the installed software and current lamp state for awards, lock behavior, and scoring.

checkBeforePlay: Confirm this is Data East Batman from 1991, not Batman Forever, The Dark Knight, or Batman '66.
Confirm the installed CPU and display revisions, ball count, Extra Ball conversion, Jackpot value, Joker timer, ramp awards, and tournament adjustments.
Test Flugelheim registration, the dropping target, Museum locks and ejects, the left-return-lane helper, Batcave feed, and ramp return before choosing the Museum route.
input.simpleOverview: Batman starts Multiball in two stages through Flugelheim and the Museum. Spell BATMAN to open the Museum, start two-ball play there, put both balls back into the Museum for three balls, then hit Flugelheim once and return to the Museum for Jackpot.
input.overview: Flugelheim hits spell BATMAN and open the Museum for two-ball play in Batman. Return both active balls to the Museum for three-ball play, hit Flugelheim once to light Jackpot, and collect it at the Museum. Use Joker Jump or ramp awards only when their returns are safer than rebuilding the cycle.
